text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Guh...!
...One more time! I won't lose this time!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ooh♡ Look, look, Trainy!
Don't Kita-chan and the others look totally youth-core right now??

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice.
I definitely don't have anything like that in me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu! Ahaha!
I see, so I won today's as well~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! A photo of my friend!
She's aiming to go overseas, but—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: A super-cute smile in front of a mega-loaded banana parfait♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Look at her! Apparently she always eats
this parfait whenever she wins a race~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Looks yummy♡ Gimme a bite," and send.
...Ah! Already got a reply.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Saved until we can eat a banana parfait together in Dubai"... A banana parfait in Dubai...?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Trainy!
I'm gonna do a bit more training!
'Cause I really wanna eat that banana parfait!!
choice_data_list: Let's work hard together for those banana parfaits!
Let's give your body a rest today.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh! Trainie, you'll come with me too??

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe.
I'll work hard side by side with my friends and Trainy."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I don't have a fierce rival to clash with...
Maybe this is my kind of youth, too♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos happily
completed the extra training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you push yourself and get hurt,
going to Dubai won't even be an option anymore.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then!
In exchange, walk me back to the dorms♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Stuff like this feels so youthfully radiant, too♡
